[spoiler=[b][u]Continued investigations and new leads[/u][/b]]

The investigation into the potentialy dangerous weapon leaks would continue with great care given to not only the details of the wepons themself but also were they might have come from and who could potentialy have the channels and ability to get them out of Nordiheim and into such dangerous hands like terrorists.

Both in Baliz and internally inside Nordiheim there would be made some rater interesting and curious discoveries.

[u]Investigation in Baliz[/u]
In the left over weapon and vehicle stockpiles from the Sal-baliz terrorist organization a great many suspicious weapons and vehciles would be found, but many of them would lack any serial numbers or identifying marks wich would sometime make it difficult to even figure out what nation it even had come from in the first place.
There was also a couple of "hybrid" weapons were parts from different nations weapons, that had most likely been damaged or unusable in its original state, had been put or forced together to make someting functional, though at various levels of success.

It also didn't help that some of the stockpiles was found to have been partialy plundered, most likely by weapons smuglers and criminals, this made it possible that weapons or equipment that could have been used to aquire evidence or clues had allready been lost, tough there was unfortunatly noting that could be done about that exept hope that this was not the case.

It was however in a part of Baliz were the THEP forces had done the first part of their attack that one of the investigation teams would do a rather supricing discovery, whitin a military facility there was found a tank from Nordiheims past, 15 'Steel Dragon' heavy tanks was found abandoned in various stages of repair and maintenance.
The 'Steel Dragon' was the biggest and heaviest tank employed by the faction created by the disposed and vengefull nobles of Nordiheim, made up of both those that had "surendered" their power and claims aswell as those that had managed to flee justice and hide from the Nordiheimians, and had been deployed and used in the "Noble War" that lasted from 1945-1950.
After the nobles eventualy lost most of the 'Steel Dragon tanks was scraped and melted down, with the exeption of 2 that was now museum pieces back in Nordiheim, What was these old tings doing in Baliz?

Closer examination however showed that they had been heavily changed and modefied to the point of basicly being a new type of tank, with the suspencion/undercarige being upgraded to more modern standards, the engine changed out with a brand new and more powerfull one and the gun, with its sights and gun systems, having been replaced with a new and bether 120mm cannon.
Specificaly it had been replaced with the cannon of the Nordiheimian ID2D-120R-AT, most likely from when the factory that was designated to make the 120 mm cannons had sold of a bunch of them on the international marked after having made way to many of them after a miss-prediction in the quanteties that the goverment would want to buy back in the late 80s.
Who ever made the modifications to these old tanks must have bought some of them, including some old LAHAT rounds wich would have allowed it actualy be dangerous.
Unfortunatly for the Sal-baliz their forces in the area had been overrun by THEP before they could get the tanks ready and make use of them.

The discovery of these tanks did pose a question though, did part of the nobles faction survive the "Nobel War"?, and were they still active?
A report of the discovery was quickly compiled and sendt back to Nordiheim.

[u]Investigation in Nordiheim[/u]

While the "tank from the past" was being discovered other things were being found out back home in Nordiheim, though the investigation started increased frustration.

The arsenals in the Red Wall Mountain Complex had been searched several times, both the active and stored ones, and the Garkain warheads there was testen in case they were fake.
Even the experimental and prototypes that was was kept for archiving and research purposes was closly  examined, but the result was the same every time, all of them was acounted for and eutenticated as the real deal.
The lists and numbers of the factory that made them also came up clean with not even a hint of deviation, wich while on one hand was realy good it also caused great frustration for investigators as it gave no clues or reason for how the one found in Nordland could even exist, yet exist it did.

It wasn't untill the people examening the mysterious warhead in a laboratory in Sorland reported some groundbreaking details about it that some clues could finaly be gained.
When they opened the warhead and examined its internal components several oddeties and slight differences was found, including the use of a component in the detonator mechanism.
This component had only been tried in the experimental faze of the warhead but was ultimatly not chosen for its potentialy unstability over longer times of storage, it was also the brainchild of one spesific scientist named Callagun Oveson.

Callagun Oveson was a rather troublesome scientist with many brushes with the law when it came to doing experiments and scientific investigations that rather often bordered on the edge of being illegal and morally questionable, sometime even being accused of human experiments wich.
He had infact only been a part of the project because of his high intelligence and ability to come up with solutions for difficult problems.
But he had been trown out of the project after evidence was found of him having done an illegal human experiment, this evidence would eventualy lead to him getting a 30 year prison sentence and loosing his credentials together with a permanent ban on being a scientist.

It had at the time been concluded that he did not now enough about the full project to be considered a treath to the securety of its technical security, but had that assumtion been incorect?
The investigation of the warhead had also showed that while it used several older designs for internal components that it had actualy must have been made rather recently, showing clear evidence of having been made in the last decade, had Callagun aquired enough information and understanding of the warhead to make a functioning one that was this close to the real ting?
Had he actualy gone the next step and joust straight up commited treason?
This had to be investigated immidiatly and as such a order was given, the man had to be put under surveilance and everyting and anyting he had been involved or in contact with since he became part of the project had to be thoroughly investigated.[/spoiler]

[spoiler=Nordiheimian moves and some apparently needed clarification of times of arrival]
[b][u]The two lower islands and dealing with the invaders[/u][/b]
(([i]This will be somewhat of a summary of things allready mentioned in the last posts, but with a general time added to remove confusion of when my air and navy forces more or less gets the two lower islands and what it more or less involves/means, It is based on the distances traveled (I checked pixels traveled together with them being 5 km long) and the speed different crafts and groups/units would realisticly be able to arrive effectively with, though I didn't give them the fastest time possible.[/i]))

[u]Day 1[/u]
Whitin the first hour Nordiheim orders their military to stop the invasion from taking over the two islands, the large fleet to the east of the two islands (in the waters more or less between the southern part of Astanir and the stronghold island of the junta) and a task force fleet from Nordiheims east-most island in the Argos strait (made up mostly up of 6 loki-class stealth corvettes with submarine suport from 2 attack submarines and the 3 njord-class submarines (at a distance)) are given orders to sail towards the two islands at full speed.
Aircraft are also scrambled to be sendt, with the  mission to take out hostile air targets and provide "eyes" on the situation.
Other preparations are also started, such as getting AA weapons to the Argossian militias.

About 3 hours after the UDF invasion the 2 stealth observation UAVs (SD1-S Mook mook) would arrive, quickly followed by airforce wings from Nordiheims airforce.
The airforce wings are led by stealth fighters (5th gen) who starts the work to figth for controll of the sky backed up by several KJ-6G Kookaburra (4.5 gen fighters) that increase in numbers over time.

About 1 hour later long distance anti-ship cruise missiles start arriving, targeting any ships on the western side of the islands using guidance provided by the UAVs.
Around this time the Nordiheimian command start reciving information/confirmation that the airforce supporting the UDF are from the PDF (Pantagruel), this changes the orders for the Nordiheimian forces to move with with more direct intent to destroy the invasion force, the actions of the Nordiheimian forces are also prepared to be declared a "intervention" to protect the two Astanir islands from an invasion from a outside nation.

[u]Day 2[/u]
Roughly around 11 am the fleet from the east and the task force from the west converges on the waters of the two islands and engages any ships belonging to the invaders with the intention of sinking them, large amount of anti-ship missiles are used to ensure success.
(The largefleet startengagement at 140 km and the task force from the west at 250 km)

The air wings continue to fight for dominance in the sky, targeting any aircraft, missiles or other airial target that they can neutralize to destroy the tactical strenght of the invading UDF forces, they are also joined by aditional wings of KJ-5H Cockatoo (3rd gen, but heavely upgraded and improved) join the fight for compleat air dominance andto increase the amount of aircraft so that the more modern fighters can dedicate more time to shoot down missiles and drones.

First AA systems starts to arrive to the Argossian militias together with point defence systems for these systems and the militias forces.
Nordiheim also declares their actions as a "intervention", pointing to the fact that the airforce of a non astanir nation is directly involved and that the Argossian militia directly asked them for help in defending their home.

[u]Day 3[/u]
A no fly zone is declared in the air space of the two islands, any aircraft that tries to aproche is told to turn away or be shot down, a combination of the navy ships there together with the fighter precense is used to enforce this.

The AA systems being sendt to the Argossian militia (AAHAML-41 Module(Basicly the MIM-104 Patriot) and AAAMS-3A Shield maiden(NASAMS 3)) starts to get propperly sett up and come online for the protection of the two islands with point defence systems (Tyr-1 Automatic AA module(Centurion C-RAM) and AAAMS-2B Valkyrie (kinda like the AN/TWQ-1 Avenger)) to protect them, these systems will give them the ability to protect their islands from air treaths.
There is also being suplied several Kangaroo MAMVI mounted AAAMS-2B Valkyries and AC-4B AA2s to help protect the militias military/militia units from missiles, rockets and missiles that is proving to be a problem for them.

The Nordiheim airforce also starts preforming ground strikes ageinst UDF forces, together with precision missiles strikes from the Battleships, to help the Argossians wear them down.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
(([i]Now to address slightly more recent happenings[/i]))

[u]Meeting new attempts[/u]
While Pantagruel would send F-117 nighthawks to try and support the UDF forces the more modern 5th gen stealth fighters and the stealth observation UAVs of Nordiheim would pose a significant treath to them with their modern systems and support from the navy assets, as they would have an actualy real chance to see and intercept them, especialy the UAVs would have a good chance as they were made with alternative ways of detecting stealth aircraft such as IRST and Passive Optical Systems.

The firing of the hidden "heavy battery systems" would not go unoticed either and they would quickly have their locations targeted and fired upon, but unfortunatly not before they got a salvo off, few of these canister shells would be successfully shot down by the limite amount of systems.
It would not take long before Nordiheim would be notefied that these canister shells contained poison gas though, promtping them to prepare actual Nordiheimian troops for future events.
These troops would be well geared and would be equiped with gasmasks for dealing with gas attacks joust incase the UDF had more at hand, and would comprice of 20'000 troops being gattered and prepared in Nordiheim together with the needed transportation assets.

There was also a massive consearn that the gas attack preformed by the UDF would have affected the civilian population, as such ships with medical personell and suplies were gattered and started to be sendt towards the islands as fast as possible, hopefull that the damage would not be to large.

[b][u]Engagement with the Restorationists fleet[/u][/b]

It would come as a bit of a suprice when the secound Nordiheimian fleet (the one with the COMINT ship) detected the Restorationists fleet and that it seemed to actualy give chase even though they were moving away from their shiping lane, did they actualy desire to engage them?

The old captain in charge of the fleet decided that while his fleet could most likely mach them in speed, and as such keep them out of range, he would allow them to engage, if they were trully foolish enough to fire at them he would have the defacto permission to fire back, and the sailors of his fleet could do with some live experience even if the power balance was most likely decidedly one sided, and it also helped that the infiltrators on the restorationists stronghold island had provided them with information about this fleets abilties, and the fact that it was made up of ships from the 70s.
By his order his fleet would turn around and sail full speed ahead, right towards the Restorationists fleet with AA systems online, anti-naval missiles with targets ready and the EW suits working together to make it hard for the enemy fleet to lock their missiles on them.

As the distance between the two fleets shortened it became apparent that the Restorationists fleet was either waiting to get withing a rather short range or having severe problems getting their missiles to lock on to them trough the EW measures used ageinst them, not until the fleets was joust above 40 km apart did they fire their missiles at the Nordiheimians.
It was rather disepointing tough as half of their missiles did not seem to have a propper lock and the other half was dealth with by the fleets AA systems, and their rate of fire was not high enough to reach the missile saturation needed for them to have an actual chance of even getting close to overwelming said AA defence in the first place, it would seem that the reports about the age and type of the ships had been correct, to old and lacking to be a real treath in these numbers.
But they had fired upon the Nordiheimian fleet, and as such they were free to fire back.

The frigates and destroyers of the restorationists fleet had no chance ageinst the salvo of missiles that they recived back, their AA far to old to deal with neither the numbers or thier ability manuver, cripeling or sinking them quickly, the cruiser on the other hand would be taken out a differnt way.
Since the distance had ended up being so short that the battleship of the fleet, NN Freja, could actualy fire at it with its 406 mm cannons that was exactly what the fleet captain ordered, for the first time since the 40s the large cannons fired on a naval ship again and the result was devestating, of the 6 explosive rounds fired 3 would hit, with one of them going trough its citadel, the poor old cruiser was borderline riped to shreds with pieces being sent flying from the large explosions the rounds made.

The old captain was rather pleased with the result, he might go down in history as the first and last captain of a battleship in the 21sth century to take a enemy ship out with the cannons of the ship, to be able to feal the shaking and sound of such large cannons giving of their roar of power from a different age and see the result in his binoculars joust like his grandfather had.
Though he suposed he would get quite the reprimand and yelling at when the admirals of the Nordiheimian navy heard that he done someting as reckless as this, but he could live with that easely enough, he was due to retire soon anyway.

He would soon recive the news that the 1 submarine that the restorationists had brought with them had been sunk by their own, an even more unfair fight realy, two modern submarines hunting a old submarine that they could see long before it could see them back.
The captain gave the order for survivors to be rescued and a report sendt to HQ about the events, then for the fleet to go and attend their current asigned task of guarding the shiping lane used to send weapons and suplies to the Argossians on mainland Astanir, atleast until they would get new orders.

[b][u]Mainland Astanir and strenghtening the Argossians ability to fight harder.[/u][/b]

It was desided by Nordiheim command that the Argossian militias in Astanir could use someting heavier to realy punch trough the lines of the nationalists to potentialy link up the main front with the Sui-mana, as such the creation of heavy armored units would be proposed to the Tribal leaders using Iron Drake 2D and 2E that they would start shiping to them together with Wombat 1 APCs, this should provide them with a armored fist to potentialy breack a whole in the nationalists lines at relative low costs of soldiers.
They would also need to get the tribal leaders to give them permission to search for people in their ranks that had potential to become pilots for fighter jets and helicopters, or if they might even have some that allready had training in it, it could become important for the Argossian militias to be able to contend for the sky with more then the different types of Anti-Air systems they were now sending them.

Though they would also need to provide them with the heavy news about how brutal the tactics of the UDF and their controller Pantagruel was, aswell as their willingness to use poison gass and potentialy even worse.
It was eventualy decided to start sending them gass masks and equipment to deal with such attacks now, rather then wait to see if it would potentialy be employed later when it could be to late.[/spoiler][/quote]
[quote=nordiheim;60445347]
[spoiler]
The moment the extent of the terrible effects of the poison gas became known to the Nordiheimians, wich would not take long, rescue efforts would take place for the desperate Argossians trying to flee.
Any navy assets that could be comandered, be it military or civilian, that could be used to pick up the Argossians was commanded by the council of Nordiheim to help in saving them.

The Naval forces of Nordiheim that was around the island would turn their weapons to protect these Argossians from any attempts form the UDF forces on the island to do anyting to treathen the saving of these people with heavy weapons fire from missiles and cannons, though if they cept away they would perhaps experiance the most silent day for them in some time, observation UAVs (both stealth and more normal) would be keeping a very close eyen on them and their movements.
Many  of the life boats on these naval vessels would also be used to help the Argossians aswell.

Any AA assets that had been delivered to the island so far, wich would now obviously be abandoned, were fired upon and destroyd so that they couldn't be taken by the UDF later.
Any donated Nordiheimian vehicles that was observed abandoned would also be targeted for destruction.

Any Argossian saved would be transported to the smaller of the two islands right of the coast of the Ostland region called Laguz island, a peacefull sialnd with a low local population that had more then enough space on it for the refugees, local atoreties would start preparing acomedations and hospital facilities with great haste to recive the now potentialy homeless Argossians.

[b][u]A plan for containment and action[/u][/b]

The mood in the military command of Nordiheim would be rather dark after reciving the news of what had happened at the two lower islands, as such it did not take much discussion to agree on a plan of action.
1) The dominance of the air space of the two islands would continue, but not bombers would be sendt to level any positions or gatterings of UDF forces.
2) The "no fly zone" would be kept up.
3) The navy would now soround the two islands and keep it and the UDF forces there cut of and isolated from the reast of they people and Pantagruel, none of them would be allowed to leave unless they fully surendered.
4) The stealth fighters would be reasigned to find the resuply planes that would have to have been used by Pantagruels F-117 Nighthawks, as the planes design would never have been able to travel the distance it would have done without arial refueling, if they were still out there then making them "blow up" from the cover of stealth would damage Pantagruels ability to use the F-117 as it could not be a airplane with a long operational range from their own experience with stealth bombers, and the numbers they had of such planes would not be infinite.
5) 2 stealth observation UAVs would be directed from the fortress island and mainland Nordiheim to the sea area between many islands that made up the whole Astanir nation to start observing what were going on there, espacialy looking for any aircraft of navy vessels belonging to the UDF or Pantagruel.

Now they joust had to find a new purpose for the small army that they had been gattering, what could they do with it that could be usefull.....
[/spoiler]
[/quote]

[i]OOC: Im not going to respond to your clarification of times for the lower islands, since there isnt much I can say. Its up to Pantagruel to respond to this as he is the controller of the UDF & PDF[/i]

[b]Gas Response[/b]
The ships of medical supplies sent to the argossians would be a noble act, but would not be able to save everyone. The ships that arrived would try to help those stranded in the sea board and escape, but the huge rush that followed would result in drowning and trampling.

On board the ships, some would still die, if treatment could not be administered quickly enough. Overall, only about a fifth of the total population of the island escaped, only to watch their entire lives get burned and choked behind them as they sailed away into the mist.

The island would now be left solely to Nordiheim to defend, along with a few surviving Guerilla soldiers who have integrated themselves into the Nordiheimian ranks.

[b]Restorationist Engagement[/b]
The Captain of the Restorationist task force would soon realise that they were outmatched. Nordiheim had more manpower, more modern equipment and more experience. However, the fleet would still fire warning shots to signal to Nordiheim that they would not allow the stronghold island to be touched, not anticipating the huge response.

Surprise and outrage would come as the Nordiheimians began speeding towards them, just before they fired the warning shots. The restorationists had been aiming to take the Nordiheimians by surprise, forcing them to run away, but instead they had made themselves vulnerable to Nordiheims far more advanced systems.

To compensate for the lack of modern technology, the restorationists would opt to fire heavily at Nordiheim rather than strategically, a method seen in use by them across the conflict, both in the water and on the land. The cannons of the outdated ships would roar to life, whilst the missiles would be sent one after the other, in hopes that they might hit, despite the EW. Eventually, the restorationists would realise that this method would not allow them to win this battle, but only after several ships had taken critical hits.

Once Nordiheim began to fire back properly, the task force would have no chance. They would be blown to pieces and sunk to the bottom of the ocean in no time. Zero trace, zero survivors.

Despite the horrific loss, the restorationists would learn something. They knew that their shipping lanes must be protected more carefully and they now knew that their island may not be the safe haven they once thought it was. As such, they would begin ramping up their defences again and once Nordiheims navy had left the area, they would deploy a huge fleet of ships to protect Restorationist waters, even diverting forces from the main island, inadvertently leaving gaps for the democrats to exploit

[b]Mainland Astanir[/b]
The new equipment given to the Argossians would be integrated into the new army of Kuhaw-Astan. Planning had now begun for a new offensive against the Restorationists, to crush the exclave to the south and to capture more coastline to the north. For now, the isolationists were still too much of a threat to get through to connect with the sui-mana.

The tribal leaders would allow Nordiheimian pilots to almost entirely control the de facto air force of Kuhaw-Astan. Since most the equipment was Nordiheimian, the control of said equipment would also be placed in the hands of Nordiheimians, who would eventually train up the argossians and hand more and more aircraft over to them, so they could eventually become militarily independent.

The horrors of the lower islands would come with great sadness to the mainland argossians. The news would motive around 1,000 volunteers to step forwards and offer themselves to the Nordiheimians for help in the battle.

[b]Negotiation with the democrats[/b]
The Sui-mana have organised negotiations between Kuhaw-Astan, Nordiheim, Qianxun and the democrats to help form a temporary alliance against the isolationists and restorationists, but also to eventually decide a future solution to the age-old Argossian vs Shamatine problem that has haunted Astanir for years.

The tribal leaders await the arrival of democratic, Qianxun and Nordiheimian representatives to the talks

O príncipe, então uma simples criança que completaria 10 anos ainda esse ano, estava vagando pelo campo, ele parecia despreocupado com qualquer coisa, e apreciava a natureza...
"Olha só, um garotinho rico vagando...imagino quanto nos pagariam se nos..."
Dois cangaceiros, vestidos em um poncho e bombacha, com um chapéu de aba larga e lenço branco no pescoço, eles apontaram duas facas para vossa alteza e disseram:
"Você aí, parado, pirralho."
Um deles sorriu com certa malícia em seus olhos, e então apontou para um cavalo marrom próximo.
"Só siga o que nós..."
Apesar do aviso, Leo pareceu irreverente quanto a isso, de fato, ignorou e passou no meio deles caminhando, como se eles nem existissem, ele sussurrou, inaudível:
"...esses Cangaceiros fedem a álcool..."
Os dois olharam com incredulidade para o garoto, ofendidos obviamente, e então um colocou o pé na frente do caminho do príncipe, que tropeçou no chão, caindo de cara na grama, eles sorriram.
"Pare de falar baboseiras, seu pai certamente nos dará uma bela recompensa pelo seu resgate."
O outro cangaceiro então bateu no ombro do companheiro, com um tom meio de pressa:
"Tsc, vamos logo Uéton."
O companheiro porém, não se importou, ao invés disso, ele levantou o príncipe pelo punho agarrando com um agarrão sujo, o príncipe parecia, assustado, mas tentava parecer forte mesmo assim.
"Bah, mas vamos lá Garrucha, só dessa vez."
O outro apenas cobre o rosto com a mão, fingindo hesitação, mas então solta uma risada:
"Gegegeheh, vamos lá então ensinar pra esse piá aí então."
Uéton respondeu com um sorriso, e então jogou o garoto contra a grama com um golpe de seu pulso contra seu rosto, com o príncipe sendo jogado contra a grama...
alguns minutos depois.
Enquanto alteza era erguido pela perna pelos cangaceiros, ele tentando lutar, em vão, se debatendo gritando;
"Eu...eu sou forte! Me larguem seus..."
[b]tack[/b].
Mas um soco, o cangaceiro companheiro do agressor, Uéton, olhou para seu parceiro e disse:
"Chega por hoje Garrucha, vambora logo."
O cangaceiro sorriu, e então levantou o príncipe agarrando pelo pescoço, com o pequeno em lágrimas e o rosto inchado, quando ia se preparar para lançar mais um golpe..
[b]Tick[/b].
Um palito de dente atingiu com precisão em seu rosto, não tinha intenção de machucar, mas distrair, ele largou o príncipe imediatamente, e quando se virou viu Maciel, um homem alto, vestimentas simples, mas chiques para o lugar.
"Você é o pai do garoto? Se quiser-"
Um dos bandidos tentou ameaçar, mas logo Maciel o cortou em sua fala, o tom sereno e calmo, como se não passasse de uma conversa casual:
"Eu só quero o garoto, e que saiam."
Os dois cangaceiros riram, e sacaram revólveres em direção de Alexandre, ele revirou os olhos e disse:
"Muito bem..."
Enquanto isso, Leo caído no chão, com os olhos marejados e rosto ferido pela agressão de antes, balbuciou palavras:
" A.. Alexandre..."
E então desmaiou contra a grama, o capitão fez um gesto breve com as mãos, o ar se tornando cortante ao seu redor como faca, cortando as armas dos bandidos, que se assustaram, arregalaram os olhos e acusaram:
"Bruxaria! Garrucha pega ele! Eu vou...ficar na retaguarda!"
Mas, não teve nem tempo para sacarem suas adagas, quando o capitão tornou o ar cortante em fios fortes que prenderam os cangaceiros, com um gesto simples, fez o ar os jogarem para longe.
Maciel olhou para o herdeiro, e com um suspiro longo, murmurou:
"vamos indo...garoto."
Ele tirou um palito do bolso de sua camisa e pôs no dente, parecendo relaxar, e então pegou o príncipe o colocando em suas costas, ainda inconsciente.
"Está tudo bem agora...vamos indo."
Algum tempo após, com o sol já se pondo e o céu laranja, e o príncipe recém acordando, ele apertou os braços ao redor do pescoço do capitão, com medo, e com um choro falou, com a voz soluçante:
"Maciel..."
Alexandre não reagiu, apenas seguiu o carregando para segurança, como se carregasse seu próprio filho, os passos eram calmos e tranquilos, sua reação foi simples:
"Você acordou..."
Mas o príncipe, não respondeu Maciel, ele afunda o rosto no ombro do capitão, com um choro abafado pelo tecido, ele agarrou o Alexandre com mais força.
"Eu só quero ser forte, eu quero..."
E repetiu isso várias e várias vezes, Maciel preferiu não responder, mas decidiu segurar sua mão suavemente, como um gesto de cuidado sutil, respondeu, não como se falasse ao filho do imperador, mas como uma criança frágil, que precisa de proteção:
"Eu sei..eu sei..."

2019, Pampas.
my lord, Prince Leo
Maciel glanced around. The fields stretched endlessly, it couldve been anywhere. The emperor had decided to take a vacation and left the state in the hands of the Prime Minister. While His Majesty was away, it was Maciels job to watch over the prince. But His Highness was a rather quick childeasy to get lost. The pampas were flat, giving a child free rein to run wherever he wanted, specifically, due to a urge to see nature out the sight of the honoured guard.

.
The prince:
The prince, a simple child who would turn ten later that year, wandered through the field, seemingly carefree, taking in the beauty of nature.
Look at that, a rich little boy wandering around I wonder how much we could get if we
Two cangaceiros appeared, wearing ponchos and baggy pants, wide-brimmed hats, and white scarves around their necks. They pointed knives at the boy.
You there! Stop, brat.
One of them grinned with a mischievous glint in his eyes and nodded toward a brown horse nearby.
Just follow our
Leo ignored them completely, strolling right between them as if they didnt exist. He whispered, just quietly enough to be unheard:
these Cangaceiros smell like booze
The two men looked at him in disbelief, clearly offended. One stepped into the boys path, making him trip and fall face-first into the grass. They smirked.
Stop babbling, your father will surely give us a nice reward for rescuing you.
The other tapped his companion impatiently on the shoulder.
Tsk, come on, Uéton.
But Uéton didnt care. Instead, he grabbed the prince by the wrist, a rough grip. The boy looked frightened but tried to stay brave.
Bah, come on, Garrucha, just this once.
The other covered his face, pretending hesitation, then laughed.
Gegegeheh, alright, lets teach this little brat a lesson.
Uéton smiled and swung the boy onto the grass with a quick twist of his wrist.
A few minutes later, the prince was dangling by his leg, struggling and shouting:
IIm strong! Let me go, you
[b]tack[/b].
A punch landed. Uéton looked at his partner.
Enough for today, Garrucha. Lets move.
Garrucha smiled and grabbed the prince by the neck. The boys face was swollen and streaked with tears. Just as he was about to strike again
[b]Tick[/b].
A toothpick struck Garruchas face precisely. It wasnt meant to hurt, only to distract. He instantly released the prince and turned to see Maciela tall man in simple but elegant clothes.
Are you the boys father? If you
One of the bandits tried to threaten him, but Maciel cut him off smoothly, his voice calm as if in casual conversation:
I only want the boy and you two to leave.
The two men laughed and raised their revolvers at Alexandre. He rolled his eyes.
I see..."
Leo lay on the grass, eyes watering, face bruised from the earlier attack. He murmured:
A Alexandre
Then he fainted. Maciel gestured briefly, and the air around him turned sharp like knives, slicing through the bandits weapons. They froze, eyes wide.
Witchcraft! Garrucha, get him! Ill cover the back!
But before they could react, Maciel shaped the sharp air into strong strands that bound the bandits and flung them aside.
He looked down at the heir, exhaling heavily.
Lets go kid."
He plucked a toothpick from his pocket, popped it in his mouth, and seemed to relax. Then he lifted the prince onto his back, still unconscious.
Everything is ok now my lord."
Some time later, with the sun setting and painting the sky orange, the prince awoke. Clinging to the captains neck, trembling, he sobbed:
Maciel
Alexandre didnt respond, just carried him safely, calm and steady, as if he were carrying his own child.
Youre awake..." 
he said in a simple tone.
But the prince didnt answer. He buried his face in the captains shoulder, muffling his sobs on the fabric, holding on tighter.
I just want to be strong, I want I want..."
He repeated it over and over. Maciel didnt reply but gently held his hand, a small gesture of care, speaking not as the emperors sons guardian but as to a fragile child who needed protection:
Yeah...yeah...I know.

Após uma longa caminhada com o príncipe nas costas, Maciel chegou a uma pequena cabana, a qual era usada pelo imperador em suas férias, ele geralmente trocava entre essa e outra, esse ano ele não estava usando essa a qual Maciel entrou, com um gesto sutil desfez a porta e a refez rapidamente, chegando lá, acendeu a luz no interruptor e se dirigiu até a cama da cabana, impecável, afinal, sempre que o imperador ia viajar, todas suas cabanas passavam por uma faxina pois ele nunca dizia onde iria passar.
Ao colocar o pequeno Leo na cama repousando, e arrumando sua bolsa médica ao lado.
Ele com um gesto, desfez a parte de cima do príncipe, mostrando seu frágil torso, não haviam ferimentos, apenas inchaços, após apalpar a região, percebeu que os ferimentos em si estavam todos no rosto, e então refez a blusa do príncipe rapidamente, pegou o pano e o molhou em uma bacia próxima, começando a limpar o sangue, o príncipe estremeceu, mas não acordou.
"O corpo, vossa alteza, é o primeiro lugar que governamos."
Ele começou a falar, com um tom solene, mesmo que soubesse que Leo estava inconsciente, ele ainda estava lá, então prosseguiu:
"Você deve conhecer ele, deve conhecer oque você governa, e seus limites, compreender seus sinais..."
Ao terminar de falar, Maciel desfez o pano em um gesto simples, retirou quaisquer umidade presente nele, e o mergulhou em outra solução médica, um pequeno frasco simples, e começou a passar no rosto e braços do príncipe, com um toque suave e gentil.
"O frio e a medicina vão ser o que irão permitir a dor passar, o resto, é com seu corpo agora ...ele sabe se reconstruir."
Maciel murmurou para si mesmo, em um tom um tanto didático, e então pegou ataduras e algodão, pronto para envolver em alguns dos hematomas.
"O corpo sabe se reconstruir, a vulnerabilidade é essencial, um imperador que nunca sentiu dor, nunca sentirá a dor de seu povo..."
Ao finalizar de envolver os hematomas, Maciel se sentou a beira da cama, iria esperar até o príncipe acordar novamente agora, mas , finalmente poderia suspirar aliviado, o que ele fez.

-
After a long walk with the prince on his back, Maciel arrived at a small hut used by the emperor on his vacations. He usually switched between these. This year, he wasn't using this one. Maciel entered. With a subtle gesture, he undoes the door and quickly rebuilds it. Once there, he flips on the light switch and heads to the hut's bed, which is spotless. After all, whenever the emperor travels, all his huts are cleaned, as he never reveals where he's staying.

Laying little Leo on the bed, he rests, arranging his medical bag beside him.

With a gesture, he undoes the prince's upper body, revealing his fragile torso. There are no wounds, only swelling. After palpating the area, he realizes that the actual wounds are all on his face. Quickly, he redoes the prince's shirt, takes the cloth, and dips it in a nearby basin, beginning to wipe away the blood. The prince shudders but doesn't wake.

"The body, my lord, is the first place we govern."
He began to speak solemnly. Even though he knew Leo was unconscious, he was still there. He continued:
"You must know him, you must know what you rule, and its limits, understand its signals..."
As he finished speaking, Maciel undid the cloth in a simple gesture, removing any moisture from it, and dipped it in another medical solution, a small, simple vial, and began to apply it to the prince's face and arms, with a soft, gentle touch.
"The cold and the medicine will be what will allow the pain to subside. The rest is up to your body now... it knows how to rebuild itself."
Maciel muttered to himself, in a somewhat didactic tone, and then grabbed bandages and cotton, ready to wrap some of the bruises. "The body knows how to rebuild itself, vulnerability is essential, an emperor who has never felt pain will never feel the pain of his people..."
After finishing wrapping the bruises, Maciel sat on the edge of the bed. He would wait until the prince woke up again now, but finally he could breathe a sigh of relief, which he did.

Gustavo "Golden Comet" Quid, a young unregistered Tessitor with a medium threat level, was the third generation of the post-CNT Tessitors, the [i]Dreamers[/i], who were born in the 2000s.
The "Golden Comet" is around 19 years old, with the long, blond hair that earned him his nickname, along with dark skin. His clothing consisted of a simple blue button-down shirt and blue jeans, separated by a dark belt around his waist that carries an IMBEL MD 1 LC pistol.
He and his companion, Isabella "Bela" Rubim, a 20-year-old woman with a slender body and silky red hair that reached her elbows. She wore a white, low-cut blouse and burgundy shorts underneath. They were both in a cafe when they saw one of the Tessitors passing by. "Look..."
Gustavo's brown eyes fixed on the tessitor, with Bela doing the same, dropping the soda she was drinking.
"If he's crazy...it's him, look there, Belinha!"
He smiled, his tone a little admiring.
"It's the Silver King! Raul Montenegro."
His walk was confident, not exaggerated, but of someone who knew what he was doing. A tall, dark-haired man of about 38, he wore round-rimmed glasses and a gray dress shirt under a dark jacket and blue jeans.
As she admired him, Bela finally realized and pulled Gustavo out the window with a quick tug:
"Pay attention, Gustavo, he's Class 1. I heard he's the second most powerful Fissicita. If he knows, he'll..."

Bela, however, pulled Quid tighter by the shoulder, still insisting:
"Come on, Gustavo. He's Class 1 and we're not registered. You know what that means? We're prey for them!"
Gustavo rolled his eyes, finally looking at his companion. He snorted as he took a bite of the sandwich he was eating.
"Oh, come on, Belinha, pay attention!"
He paused dramatically, clearing his throat, and then continued, excitement still in his voice:
"I heard that with a simple gesture, he can compress a car to look like a soda can! Isn't that awesome?"
His eyes shone with excitement and admiration.
"Because him being awesome is different from [i]see[/i] him awesome."
She retorted, irritation already in her voice, grabbed her bag, and got up from the seat. "Now, this coffee's already too cold for my taste, I'm going to call it a day."

"Your perception is commendable, young man."

"R-Raul Montenegro?"

"It's me, yes, Gustavo Quid? The Golden Comet? And..."
